definitions.explanation: A language designated for use in government, law, and official business of a country or region. A country may have one or multiple official languages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公用語|こうようご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: English is one of the official languages.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{公用語|こうようご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This country has four official languages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{公用語|こうようご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧、{仏語|ふつご}、⟦{中国語|ちゅうごくご}→中国語：10966_chuugokugo⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧つ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The United Nations has six official languages, including English, French, and Chinese.

notes:
Japan has no legally designated {公用語|こうようご} — Japanese is the de facto national language but is not formally codified as the official language in the constitution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公用語|こうようご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (designate as an official language)
- {公用語|こうようご}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (be used as an official language)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {公用語|こうようご}: official language (legally designated for government use)
- ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧: national language (the language of a nation, also the school subject)
- ⟦{母語|ぼご}→母語：13228_bogo⟧: mother tongue, native language
